# Test DOT/Graphviz format generation

# Generate dot from file
sc dot chart.json
stdout 'digraph statechart'
stdout 'rankdir=TB'
stdout 'Red -> Green'
stdout 'node \[shape=box'

# Test rankdir flag
sc dot -rankdir LR chart.json
stdout 'rankdir=LR'

-- chart.json --
{
  "root_state": {
    "label": "__root__",
    "type": 2,
    "children": [
      {"label": "Red", "type": 1, "is_initial": true},
      {"label": "Green", "type": 1}
    ]
  },
  "transitions": [
    {"from": ["Red"], "to": ["Green"], "event": "NEXT"}
  ]
}
